item.title: Sky Islands
item.creator: inPixel
item.description:
Rediscover your world with Sky Islands! Fly through the skies on tamable clouds, explore floating islands in different biomes. Mine new ores, forge fusion armor, and trade with the Sky Villagers who live high above the clouds.

- 72 islands
- 4 Armor sets, 4 Swords, 4 Tools
- Custom villagers
- by inPixel

* Please back up your world in advance! *

howToEntries.content:
Welcome to Sky Islands Guide!

Explore the skies and find new kinds of minerals to craft armor and new friends along the way!

There are 4 sets of new sky armor, each is crafted from ores found on different Islands! To craft the armor, place the new ores in a similar layout to Vanilla Minecraft!

Ancient Armor grants Speed, Regen, and Poison Immunity!
Frozen Armor grants Frost Walker and Freeze Immunity!
Blazing Armor grants Fire resistance and Speed!
Leaf Armor grants Regeneration and Saturation!

To upgrade the armor, use 9 Adamendite shards, which can be found on all island types, to craft a block in the crafting table! Then you can merge with the armor in the crafting table to have bonus effects!

Sky Islands will also be populated with new villagers that trade these new ores, amongst other things!

You can also use Adamendite to craft an Elevator! Using an Eye of Ender in the top center, an Adamendite block in the middle, fill the remaining slots in the crafting table with Adamendite shards!

Along with 4 new sets of armor, we have also added new tools and weapons!
Each new sword can be crafted with 2 new ores of the same kind in the top-middle and middle slots, along with a stick in the bottom-middle slot!

Frozen Sword - Basic attack applies slowness; special attack shoots out ice spikes towards the enemy!
Leaf Sword - Basic attack heals when you kill; special attack creates a destructive leaf tornado!
Blazing Sword - Basic attack ignites your enemies; special attack shoots out flames!
Ancient Sword - Basic Attack applies poison; special attack throws a giant rock!

The new tools can be crafted using Adamendite, similar to the normal vanilla recipe for each crafting tool.

Adamendite Shovel - Creates pathways where you sneak-click!
Adamendite Axe - Chops connected logs for faster tree farming!
Adamendite Pickaxe - Mine connected ores easily!
Adamendite Hoe - Tiles a larger area with a click!

We've also added a new pet!
Sky Cloud! He's friendly, until you try to hit him. He's very fun to bounce on, and to tame him, you can use Adamendite Shards! Once tamed, you can click on him and ride him from Island to island!
